name: omapixel
author: haripako
description: Pixel and Pixel Buds status in the bar: earbuds battery, phone link, and file transfers

barWidget.description: Earbuds battery, phone link and transfer status, read from omapixel-status

schema.label: Status command
schema.description: Path to omapixel-status. Empty looks for it on PATH. This widget never talks to Bluetooth or to any tool directly; everything it draws comes from this one command.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Deliberately not one second. A full status call was measured at 2.09 s on the reference machine, almost all of it a fixed discovery wait inside kdeconnect-cli, so polling fast would leave a process permanently hanging.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is available
schema.description: Off by default. A missing widget teaches nobody why; a widget saying what to install or start does.
